title: Jean Lafitte Harbor

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Jean Lafitte Harbor offers an extreme inland salt water fishing experience! We specialize in red fish and speckled trout. No need to worry about your fishing gear-our charter captains will provide it! Team Lafitte Harbor is your ticket to some of the best fishing along the Louisiana Gulf Coast, less than one hour from the New Orleans French Quarter. You have quick access to fantastic inshore fishing - the largest and most dynamic fishing grounds in the world. Anglers find marshes teaming with flounder, redfish, speckled trout and sheepshead, all within minutes form our dock.
